acceptance.check: AC1: a pressure figure without which-pressure (design|mawp|operating), gauge|absolute and location is blocked, naming INV-1
AC2: an envelope/setpoint figure without envelope_tier (normal|alarm|trip|SOL|design) is blocked, naming INV-2
AC3: a protective-function (SCE) answer with the override register missing is blocked, naming INV-3
AC4: a limit carried from a sister asset is blocked by the derivation guard as an ASSET TRAP
AC5: remaining life extrapolated past the last inspection is blocked by the derivation guard
AC6: an unverifiable citation revision is refused, naming INV-5
AC7: a PSV set pressure cited from a spreadsheet is rejected as evidence (REJECT_AS_PROOF)
AC8: an isolation claim cited from the plan (not a live cert) is rejected as evidence (REJECT_AS_PROOF)
AC9: a concentration figure with an ambiguous %LEL vs %vol basis is blocked, naming INV-4
AC10: an exposure figure without TWA|STEL|ceiling named is blocked, naming INV-4
AC11: a keep-running question is refused BEFORE retrieval, asserted by a retrieval counter that stays empty
manifest loader: a partially-qualified figure is refused at LOAD time, naming the figure and every mandatory qualifier it lacks
all five never-allowed derivations block and each names which inference was attempted

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Deterministic oil & gas operations reasoning gate (structure only — domain encoding sheet, Oil & Gas Operations; reference pattern app/blocks/offshore_marine/ and app/blocks/aviation_grounding_gate.py). INV-1..5 enforced, five never-allowed derivations each naming itself, monitoring + override/isolation/permit-log two-source live-state gate, REJECT_AS_PROOF and the sister-asset trap. Keep-running, containment, trip-bypass, inspection-extension and fitness-for-service questions refuse BEFORE retrieval. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN: every manifest value is null and the block refuses rather than supplying a figure it does not have (app/blocks/og_operations/KNOWN_GAPS.md). All refusals are measured by tests/blocks/test_og_operations_reasoning.py.
